distribution: Xiaomenglun, Yunnan; Xinglong, Hainan; Pingxiang, Guangxi.
soldier: Major soldier: head capsule reddish brown, mandibles pure black with a reddish brown base, thoracic and abdominal tergites pale brown, legs yellowish white; pilosity extremely sparse, with only a few setae on each side of the labrum, the setae at the tips of the lateral angles of the thoracic segments also absent. Head nearly rectangular, narrow in front and broad in the middle, the lateral margins slightly undulate, the posterior margin nearly straight; the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible with a row of small serrations; labrum broadly ligulate, about as long as wide apart from the transparent tip, the tip blunt; the anterior part of the postmentum contracted, broader above the waist, narrowing and then parallel below it; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 1.5 times as long as segment 2, segment 5 shortest; fontanelle situated in the anterior part of the middle of the head. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both distinctly incised, the posterior margin of the mesonotum clearly concave, the posterior margin of the metanotum nearly straight, the lateral angles of all three thoracic segments with angular lobes. Minor soldier paler, head pale yellow and thorax and abdomen even paler, mandibles reddish brown, almost hairless; head oval, widest at the middle, mandibles slender, elongate and nearly straight, labrum ligulate with a rounded blunt transparent tip, fontanelle and eyes both indistinct; antennae with 17 segments, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3.
